Interface ApplicationInfo

    • platform

      be.imgn.gaia.core.platform.Platform platform()
      Returns the platform the application runs on: the Platform bean, which this method is a shortcut to. Core's default is Platform.current(); a bean of an application, or a binding, replaces it.
      Returns:
      the platform
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if called before the root injector is built

    • directories

      be.imgn.gaia.core.platform.ApplicationDirectories directories()
      Returns the application's directories: the ApplicationDirectories bean, which this method is a shortcut to. Core's default derives them from the Platform bean and the application's names; a bean of an application, or a binding, replaces it.
      Returns:
      the directories
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if called before the root injector is built
